The Cash and Trade Proc Analyst 2 is an intermediate level role responsible for managing technology projects throughout the entire system development lifecycle in coordination with the Transaction Services team. The overall objective is to research and implement sustainable technology solutions, increase efficiency and reduce costs.

Responsibilities:

  • Research, identify and recommend technology capabilities that enable the reduction of client inquiries and manual touch points
  • Research current treasury and client operational trends and suggest solutions
  • Work in partnership with vendors, technology, and client operations teams to prototype innovative solutions
  • Propose and implement solutions that will increase operating efficiency and lead to an improved client experience
  • Assist efforts to help drive high rates of client adoption
  • Ensure requirements are clearly stated and that business and client needs are met throughout development
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a related role
  • Proven system development lifecycle skills
  • Proficient understanding of emerging technologies
  • Effective verbal and written skills
  • Effective analytic and presentation skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 55961

Principal Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership:

Act as a hands-on lead developer, guiding the team in designing, developing, and deploying high-quality software solutions.

Provide technical mentorship to a team of multiple teams of developers, ensuring best practices in coding, design, and architecture.

Drive the adoption of modern development frameworks, tools, and methodologies.

  • Product Development:

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand technical and customer needs, aligning them with the product vision.

Take ownership of greenfield projects, leading them from inception to production release.

Ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that meet business requirements.

  • System Design and Implementation:

Architect and implement solutions using Java, Spring Framework, and Spring Integration.

Design and integrate secure authentication mechanisms using OAuth 2.0.

Develop and maintain robust data storage solutions using MongoDB.

  • Cloud and DevOps:

Leverage AWS services to build and deploy cloud-native applications.

Implement containerized solutions using Kubernetes for scalability and reliability.

Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to ensure smooth deployment processes.

  • Collaboration and Communication:

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, QA engineers, and operations teams.

Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing updates on project progress and technical challenges.

Requirements

  • Technical Expertise:

At least 8 years of hands-on experience in 5 or more of the following technologies: Java, Spring Framework (including Spring Integration), OAuth 2.0, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes and Jenkins Pipeline.

  • Leadership Skills:

Proven experience leading a team of multiple teams of developers, providing technical guidance and fostering a collaborative environment.

Ability to mentor junior developers and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

  • Product Ownership:

Strong product owner mentality, with a focus on understanding technical and customer needs while aligning with the product vision.

Experience in delivering greenfield projects from concept to production release.

  • Problem-Solving and Communication:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.

Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Skills (Preferred But Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with microservices architecture.

Familiarity with other cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, GCP).

Knowledge of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

  • 假期福利

除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。

  • 全面的福利保险计划

包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。

  • 员工体检

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

  • 弹性福利

  • 心理健康咨询

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

  • PSQP专业进修计划

专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

The Research Sr Associate is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

  • Citi Research focuses on delivering high quality investment insights to investors with a high emphasis on independence and objectivity in its products and insights
  • The unit produces regular written research, hosts investor meetings with company management teams, holds conference calls with industry consultants and regularly communicates with clients (both internal and external)
  • Modeling: Maintaining & updating existing company models; creating new models; maintaining relative value sheets
  • Research: Assist with the publication of earnings previews/recaps, initiation reports, deep dive notes as well other group products
  • Communication: Assist with client inquires and requests (internal and external)
  • Events: Assist with coordination of investor meetings (management meeting & field trips) and conference calls with consultants
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years previous experience
  • MBA or graduate degree and/or CFA preferred.
  • Experience in Credit Research
  • Good knowledge of accounting and modelling with a credit focus
  • Experience in supporting senior credit research analysts
  • Excellent inter-personal and writing skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Job Summary

  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control, including but not limited to
  • contribute in the formulation or amendment of audit, risk control and accountability policies
  • participate in the internal investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of failure to perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support city CFCR team to contribute to the effective management of risks.
  • The CFCR function within the branch is the independent oversight on behalf of senior management of those core processes and related policies and procedures that seek to ensure the bank is in conformity with industry-specific laws and regulations in letter and spirit, thereby support city CFCR team helping to maintain the bank’s reputation.
  • Support city CFCR to ensure the effectiveness of the management of Compliance and Regulatory Risk issues by taking branch responsibility and leadership for compliance & Regulatory Risk. Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced AVP Business Analyst to lead Back Office and trade-lifecycle analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets initiatives. The role bridges Front Office product and payoff understanding with downstream execution across validation, lifecycle processing, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.

The ideal candidate is a senior, hands-on Business Analyst with strong cross-asset product and payoff literacy, deep Back Office domain expertise, and the ability to shape solutions, challenge gaps and drive decisions across multi-system initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Contribute cross-asset product, operations, finance, control and technology insights to Back Office and trade-lifecycle roadmaps, supporting prioritisation based on business value, operational readiness, risk and delivery feasibility.
  • Shape recommendations across complex or strategically important cross-platform initiatives, challenge assumptions and influence decisions through product expertise, end-to-end impact analysis and stakeholder alignment.

Business

  • Own Back Office and trade-lifecycle impact analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets product and platform initiatives across validation, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.
  • Translate Front Office product and payoff economics into clear, testable downstream requirements, including booking-model controls, lifecycle events, accounting entries, PSGL ChartFields, cash and settlement flows, and customer outputs.
  • Partner with Product Owners, operations, finance, engineering, architecture, quality engineering and business stakeholders to refine scope, resolve design gaps and prioritise the delivery backlog.
  • Assess cross-system impacts, dependencies, options and risks, including bifurcation versus non-bifurcation treatment across lifecycle, settlement, accounting and customer outputs.
  • Define and support SIT and UAT scenarios, expected results, data validation, reconciliation checks, defect triage, implementation readiness and post-release validation; create test cases where required.
  • Maintain traceability from business outcomes and product economics through requirements, controls, delivery, testing and acceptance.
  • Lead business analysis for complex, cross-system and strategically significant initiatives. Define the analysis approach, resolve ambiguity, manage competing stakeholder needs and own the quality and completeness of end-to-end lifecycle analysis.

Processes

  • Analyse current-state trade-lifecycle processes across booking hand-off, validation, lifecycle events, settlement, payments, accounting, reconciliation, controls and customer outputs, identifying opportunities for simplification, automation and control improvement.
  • Define future-state processes, business rules, data flows, accounting treatment, exception handling, reconciliation and operational impacts for new or enhanced capabilities.
  • Ensure process, requirement, decision, control and traceability artefacts remain current, consistent and accessible throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Lead end-to-end process analysis across functions, systems and markets, and influence agreement on material lifecycle, operating-model, accounting and control changes.

People & Talent

  • Provide functional guidance, coaching and quality oversight to Business Analysts working on related Back Office and trade-lifecycle initiatives.
  • Lead peer reviews and promote consistent business analysis standards, reusable assets and good practices.
  • Support capability development, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the chapter, including cross-asset product, trade lifecycle, settlement, finance and control knowledge.

Risk Management

  • Identify, assess, document, escalate and support resolution of delivery, operational, finance, conduct, regulatory, data and technology risks across the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
  • Anticipate material risks and control gaps across complex initiatives, challenge proposed approaches where required, and drive agreement on proportionate mitigation, ownership and closure.

Governance

  • Ensure all analysis, control, testing and assurance artefacts meet required standards and policies, including SCB Governance Standards and ESDLC.
  • Define and oversee the analysis governance approach for complex initiatives, assure the quality of key artefacts, and resolve significant lifecycle, accounting, settlement or control gaps before governance or delivery decisions.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Influences senior and cross-functional stakeholders, resolves conflicting priorities and establishes alignment across complex initiatives.
  • Product Owners and business sponsors, for scope, requirements, value and prioritisation.
  • Operations, Finance, Product Control, Engineering Leads, Domain Tech Leads, Architects and Quality Engineering, for solution design, controls, testing and delivery.

Skills And Experience

  • Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyse and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  • Software Product Business Knowledge: Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; knowledge of the install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.
  • Application Delivery Process: Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.
  • Software Change Request Management: Knowledge of, and experience with, managing product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
  • Software Quality Assurance: Knowledge of software quality assurance activities, tasks, tools and techniques, and the ability to evaluate new or enhanced systems, software packages and software tools to ensure adherence to functionality and quality requirements.
  • Release Management: Knowledge of activities, practices, deliverables and application release techniques; ability to manage and control the implementation of new or enhanced applications into a production/live environment.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Training

  • Typically 12 or more years of relevant experience in business analysis or financial services technology, including leadership of complex, cross-system or cross-functional initiatives across Wealth Management or Financial Markets.
  • Strong Front Office product/payoff literacy, with ability to understand how pricing, payoff and lifecycle events drive downstream treatment.
  • Deep Back Office domain expertise in Financial Markets / Wealth Management products, especially complex derivatives and structured payoffs.
  • Working knowledge of trade validation, trade controls, lifecycle processing, settlement and reconciliation across multi-system environments.
  • Working knowledge of settlement and payment messaging, including SWIFT and ISO20022 concepts relevant to trade lifecycle and nostro / settlement processes.
  • Strong understanding of finance/accounting impacts, including PSGL, ChartFields, accounting entries, sub-ledger concepts and reconciliation requirements.
  • Clear understanding of customer outputs: advices, statements, confirmations, contract notes and how payoff economics should be represented.
  • Comfortable working system-agnostically across trading, core banking, settlement, finance, reconciliation and reporting platforms.
  • Hands-on analytical skills, including SQL or equivalent query capability for investigation and validation.
  • Fluent, confident communicator able to facilitate senior working sessions and influence decisions.

Languages

  • Proficient in Business English (written and verbal communication).

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 28 February 2027

Job Description

Title Senior Analyst II – Enterprise Network Services Developer

Department Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services

Location Dalian

Reports To Senior Technical Manager - Enterprise Network Traffic Gateway

Level Grade 3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

The position is part of the Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services (ENS) group within the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) division. EIS delivers secure, reliable, and globally accessible IT infrastructure across both on‑premises and cloud environments to support Fidelity’s applications, digital services, and dynamic working models.

ENS plays a critical role in delivering secure, scalable, and innovative network solutions that power global enterprise operations. We are a global team of 70+ professionals across the UK, Europe, India, and APAC. ENS transitioned to an accountability-based operating model in Q1 2026. Under this model, the organization is structured into seven technical service groups, each led by a manager who serves as both a people leader and the accountable owner for their services. These groups include Network Engineering, Core Network, Network Security, Traffic Gateway, End User Connectivity, Multimedia, and Common Services.

As part of Fidelity’s broader technology transformation strategy, ENS is accelerating the adoption of AWS and Azure cloud platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, DevOps engineering practices, API integration, and end-to-end service automation. This transformation aims to improve operational efficiency, service reliability, scalability, and engineering agility while enabling our teams to leverage modern cloud-native technologies and automation capabilities.

About Your Role

As a DevOps Engineer within ENS, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting automation solutions across multiple ENS technology domains. The role acts as a shared engineering capability supporting a broad portfolio of enterprise network, security and multimedia services, helping product teams accelerate delivery through modern DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

About You

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology, automation, and continuous improvement, and who are excited about contributing to the next generation of Enterprise Network Services at Fidelity.

While the role is primarily focused on DevOps and automation engineering, a genuine interest in networking, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise technology platforms is important for long-term success.

The successful candidate will possess a strong software engineering mindset, excellent problem-solving abilities and a passion for automation. The role requires an individual who can bridge traditional infrastructure engineering with modern DevOps practices, enabling ENS teams to accelerate delivery while maintaining operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Netowrk Automation & Operational Support

  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools.
  • Support automation of network provisioning, configuration management and operational processes across ENS services.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of Terraform modules and automation workflows.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting application, infrastructure and platform deployments using DevOps best practices.
  • Integrate network, cloud and security platforms through APIs and automation frameworks.
  • Support network technologies including routing, switching, DNS, VPN, load balancing, firewalls and cloud networking.
  • Contribute to monitoring, reporting, compliance validation and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Produce technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge articles.
  • Participate in operational support including on-call, troubleshooting and continuous improvement activities.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with Network, Cloud, Security and Collaboration teams to deliver automation solutions.
  • Support infrastructure and transformation projects through automation and engineering best practices.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and solution reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • 3-8 years of experience in Network Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and infrastructure automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to Terraform, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), or configuration management tools.
  • Experience with Git and version control practices.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and DevOps methodologies.
  • Good understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, Routing & Switching, VPN, Load Balancing, and Network Security.
  • Familiarity with Firewalls, SDN, SD-WAN, Zero Trust concepts, and Cloud Networking technologies.
  • Basic knowledge of Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms and related networking services.
  • Understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies and operational support processes.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or container technologies is desirable but not required.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across global teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Impact on the Business/Function

  • Support the achievement of Country AOP
  • Achieve agreed Key Performance Indicator objectives by development of existing and new relationships
  • Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
  • Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advice them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
  • Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and

WPB performance

  • Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
  • Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
  • Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
  • Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
  • Fully utilise and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Own the client relationship with HSBC
  • Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximise revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
  • Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
  • Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
  • Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

Leadership & Teamwork

  • To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
  • Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
  • Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch WPB Performance measures and plan to support the multi channel client journey
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider WPB businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Ensuring that sales and operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
  • Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
  • Manage operational risk, by using relevant Management Information to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimise loss

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Knowledge & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of three years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
  • Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
  • Strong technical skills in wealth management
  • Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
  • Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
  • Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
  • Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
  • Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by HBCN
  • Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
  • Able to communicate well in English and local languages

Accreditations

  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Knowledge Management Enablement Lead.

As Knowledge Management Enablement Lead within Risk and Compliance and the Chief AI Officer function you’ll accelerate adoption of HSBC’s enterprise knowledge and knowledge-intelligence layer across R&C Value Streams. This is a transformation and change role focused on enablement and adoption rather than building the underlying platform which is delivered by a separate BAU knowledge and data team. You’ll connect knowledge foundations to the agentic AI migration agenda partnering closely with Value Streams and the AI Enablement Lead. Success means more workflows and use cases onboarded onto the knowledge-intelligence layer with clear data and knowledge readiness coverage across Value Streams. You’ll also improve how quickly Value Stream requirements are translated into governed build-ready designs and how consistently adoption is measured and reported.

Principal responsibilities

  • Act as the change and adoption enabler for knowledge management and knowledge-intelligence standards across R&C Value Streams
  • Partner with Value Streams to understand and translate knowledge and unstructured-data needs into governed build-ready designs
  • Coordinate with the BAU knowledge and data engineering team to prioritise and enable delivery of the knowledge-intelligence layer including FIBO-aligned ontology semantic layer hybrid search and GraphRAG foundations
  • Maintain clear scope boundaries and RACI with the BAU team so build and operational accountability is not duplicated
  • Own the interface between knowledge management delivery and the agentic AI migration agenda to ensure knowledge foundations are fit for purpose for AI migration and Value Stream AI workflows
  • Track and report adoption of the knowledge layer across Value Streams
  • Support the Head of AI Monitoring and Governance on evidence and data-quality standards relevant to knowledge management

Requirements

  • Bring experience in knowledge management information architecture or data and content strategy
  • Apply familiarity with RAG semantic search or related knowledge-intelligence concepts
  • Translate business needs into governed delivery designs across business and technical teams
  • Partner effectively with senior stakeholders across Value Streams product owners AI leads and central enablement teams
  • Deliver change or transformation outcomes with clear adoption measures and reporting
  • Work comfortably with unstructured data requirements and knowledge standards in a governed environment
  • Bring financial services experience with exposure to Risk and Compliance where available

Who we are looking for

Fund Accountant Associate 2 will be responsible for supporting a range of operational and fund accounting activities for the client portfolio. The role requires a strong understanding of investment lifecycle events, operational controls and supporting documentation. The successful candidate will independently manage assigned responsibilities, investigate exceptions and work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.

The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.

What you will be responsible for

  • Independently process investment lifecycle events, including capital calls, distributions, interest receipts, fee transactions, paydowns and other investment-related activities..
  • Review and maintain supporting documentation received from agents, administrators and counterparties.
  • Support cash processing and cash reconciliation activities by comparing transaction records against supporting documentation and internal systems.
  • Assist in setup and maintenance of investment attributes and operational records within relevant platforms.
  • Monitor and investigate basic exceptions, missing information and reconciliation breaks.
  • Escalate issues and outstanding items promptly to senior team members.
  • Support preparation of operational reports and client deliverables.
  • Maintain accurate audit trails and document management records.
  • Follow established procedures, risk controls and information-security requirements.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and support testing activities when required.


What we value

This position provides an opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of alternative investment products and operational activities, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and other complex investment structures. The successful candidate will develop expertise in investment operations, cash management, documentation review and client servicing activities within a global operating environment.

We Value

  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Problem-solving mindset
  • Effective communication
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Teamwork and collaboration
  • Continuous improvement mindset


Education And Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
  • Approx 2 years related experience of relevant experience within fund accounting, fund administration, financial services or alternative investment operations.
  • Understanding of alternative investment structures and investment lifecycle events preferred.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify issues, investigate exceptions and escalate appropriately.


Role scope and working relationships

The Associate 2 role is critical in ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of operational processing while supporting a strong control environment and high-quality client service. The role works closely with middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
